title: omfp views manifest
description: <workspace>/.omfp/views.json: the views of a workspace's window (AGT-010). Views are listed in id order; `default` (else the first id) is the one a window opens. Unknown keys are ignored.

default.description: Id of the view a window opens; must be a key of `views`.

panels.description: Floating panels over every view of the workspace, by id, in id order (AGT-060): each a node like a view's layout; the `title` prop labels the panel. omfp_ui_mount { panel: true } writes them, closing one removes it.

view.description: A layout (`layout`) or a TSX view file (`view`, AGT-074); not both.

title.description: Shown in the mode line's view tabs; default: the id.

view.description: `./views/<name>.tsx` (also .ts, .jsx, .js): <workspace>/.omfp/views/<name>.tsx, an ES module whose default export is a React component returning the omfp/sdk layout components (Row, Col, Tabs, Stack, Widget) that lay out the view. It is compiled and imports like a widget file; relative imports reach the other files of .omfp/views/. A TSX view takes no mounts: edit the file instead.

node.description: A widget reference, [reference, props], or [container, props, ...children].

oneOf.description: [container, props, ...children]: at least one child; `sizes` (flex weights) has one positive number per child.

reference.description: `omfp:<name>` (built-in: omfp:header, omfp:chat, omfp:transcript, omfp:interactions, omfp:composer, omfp:workspace, omfp:changes, omfp:background, omfp:todos, omfp:debug, omfp:tree, omfp:activity, omfp:mcp, omfp:file, omfp:terminal, omfp:jobs, omfp:web, omfp:browser; a workspace widget of the same name replaces it; the retired omfp:subagents shows omfp:background), `./widgets/<name>` (<workspace>/.omfp/widgets/<name>/) or `user:<name>` (<data-dir>/widgets/<name>/). An unknown reference shows an error in place of the widget.

props.description: Passed to the widget as React props. `instance` (a string) identifies the widget instance for useStored and useJob; default: the reference. `title` labels a tab.
